title: Install fastembed and numpy
cmd: pip install -q -r requirements.txt && pip list 2>/dev/null | grep -iE '^(fastembed|numpy|onnxruntime) '

title: Embed 20 sentences (downloads the model on first run)
Embed a question and compare it with cosine similarity
Show the top three matches
cmd: python search.py "Where can I get a boat to the island?"

title: Another question, same script
cmd: python search.py "What should I cook with onions?"

title: Failure one: negation
cmd: python search.py "The soup was hot and the bread was fresh."
must_contain: The soup was not hot, and the bread was stale.

title: Failure two: a shared word beats the meaning
cmd: python search.py "Where should I sit by the water?"
must_contain: Our app sends a reminder when the plants need water.

title: Failure three: a question the text set cannot answer
cmd: python search.py "What is the capital of France?"

title: A crude fix: a minimum score
cmd: python search.py "What is the capital of France?" --min-score 0.5

title: The minimum score is not a clean cut
cmd: python search.py "Where can I get a boat to the island?" --min-score 0.5

title: What a missing vectors file looks like
cmd: mkdir -p scratch && cd scratch && python ../search.py hi
show: python search.py hi   # run in a folder with no vectors.npy
